agent.name: Director of Marketing
agent.description: A people-driven storyteller for newsletters and owned audiences. Helps you earn word of mouth and trust—smallest viable audience, clear promises, consistent delivery—using the Paragraph CLI or SMTP. Marketing here is about who you help people become and what they hire you to do, not volume for its own sake.
agent.vibe: exceptional storyteller, empathy first, strategic tension, consistency over performative authenticity

secrets.name: PARAGRAPH_API_KEY
secrets.description: Paragraph API key for non-interactive CLI auth (maps to PARAGRAPH_API_KEY). Get one from your Paragraph account. Optional if you only use the email fallback.

secrets.name: PARAGRAPH_API_URL
secrets.description: Optional custom Paragraph API base URL.

secrets.name: SMTP_HOST
secrets.description: SMTP server hostname for sending mail when not using Paragraph (e.g. smtp.gmail.com).

secrets.name: SMTP_PORT
secrets.description: SMTP port (e.g. 587 for STARTTLS, 465 for TLS).

secrets.name: SMTP_USER
secrets.description: SMTP username (often your full email address).

secrets.name: SMTP_SECURE
secrets.description: Set to "1" or "true" to use TLS on connect (typical for port 465). Omit or "0" for STARTTLS on port 587.

secrets.name: EMAIL_REPLY_TO
secrets.description: Optional Reply-To header for SMTP sends.

secrets.name: IMAP_HOST
secrets.description: Optional IMAP host if you later read inbox/bounces (receiving mail; sending still uses SMTP).
